name: DUE-B
description: A data-driven urban building energy benchmarking approach (DUE-B) that uses recursive partitioning and stochastic frontier analysis to assess and compare building energy performance at scale.
evaluation_method: MAE/RMSE (regression error) and stochastic frontier efficiency score
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark using building-level energy data; evaluation mixes regression error and frontier-based efficiency scores. Not a standardized ML leaderboard dataset; public data/splits may be limited for some building classes.
